title: Learning the Platform, Not the Learner: Sequencing Shortcuts in the Offline Evaluation of Educational Recommender Systems and LLM Rankers
abstract: arXiv:2611.33240v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Educational recommenders are usually compared offline, by how well they predict the next activity in logs of tutoring systems, learning applications and MOOCs, where the next activity is largely decided by the platform: teachers assign problem sets, tutors draw problems until mastery, engines select questions. On eight public datasets from five platforms, we compare four structural predictors, which use nothing about the learner beyond the last activity, with ten personalised recommenders and with open-weight LLM rankers from 0.5 to 7 billion parameters, under two protocols. The structural predictors reach between 0.81 and 1.00 of the best accuracy of any method (median 0.95), mostly through population transitions rather than the course order; the best personalised recommender is significantly better on five datasets, by 0.007 to 0.102 NDCG@10, and on Eedi in three of four training runs. Every method is far less accurate on steps along

translated_title: 学习平台而非学习者：教育推荐系统与LLM排序器离线评估中的序列捷径
translated_abstract: 教育推荐系统通常通过离线方式进行评估，即衡量其在辅导系统、学习应用和MOOC日志中预测下一个活动的能力，而下一个活动在很大程度上是由平台决定的：教师布置习题集，辅导教师反复抽题直至掌握，引擎自动选择题目。在来自五个平台的八个公开数据集上，我们在两种协议下比较了四种结构化预测器（除最后一个活动外不使用任何学习者信息）、十个个性化推荐器以及参数量从0.5到70亿的开源LLM排序器。结果显示，结构化预测器达到了任何方法最佳准确率的0.81到1.00之间（中位数0.95），且这主要源于群体层面的转换规律而非课程顺序；最佳个性化推荐器仅在五个数据集上显著更优，NDCG@10提升0.007到0.102，并且在Eedi数据集的四次训练中仅有三次更优。
tldr: 该论文发现在教育推荐系统的离线评估中，仅依赖平台行为规律、完全不使用学习者信息的简单结构化预测器就能达到最佳个性化推荐器和LLM排序器81%到100%的准确率，揭示了现有离线评估基准主要在衡量平台序列行为而非真正的学习者建模能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that simple structural predictors relying solely on platform sequencing patterns—using nothing about the learner beyond the last activity—achieve 81-100% of the best accuracy of personalized recommenders and LLM rankers in offline evaluation, exposing that current offline benchmarks largely measure platform behavior rather than genuine learner modeling.
